{{Top|leg}}
A '''ponji stick''' was a row of hydraulic rods that could potentially pierce the foot of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. One was installed in the pain pipe, a training simulation chamber, at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]] and was used by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] during an outbreak of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Sickness]].<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>
